# Sixth Degree

Sixth Degree is a creator-to-brand marketplace built in Toronto, Canada. Brands
hire verified nano and micro creators (fashion, food, fitness, beauty, travel,
tech, lifestyle, gaming). Payments are held in escrow, verification is decided
by humans and re-checked every 90 days, and traced links and promo codes give
brands a verifiable floor on results.

Who it's for:
- Toronto (and Canadian) brands that want to hire real, verified local creators
- Nano and micro creators who want fair, escrow-backed brand deals

Key facts:
- Verified-only hiring, enforced by the platform
- Creators keep 100% of their quoted fee; funds release when the brand confirms
  the post is live, or automatically after 3 business days
- Brands pay a platform fee on top, shown before funding a collaboration
- Canadian-first; Toronto first, with Brazil and Colombia planned next
- Private beta opens Fall 2026
